description: This file contains Redux action creators and async functions for searching posts and files, handling missing channels, and managing search state in the Mattermost web application.

methods.name: getMissingChannelsFromPosts
methods.description: Fetches missing channel data for posts by dispatching getChannel, getChannelAndMyMember, and getChannelMembers for each post's channel ID.

methods.name: getMissingChannelsFromFiles
methods.description: Fetches missing channel data for files by dispatching getChannel, getChannelAndMyMember, and getChannelMembers for each file's channel ID.

methods.name: searchPostsWithParams
methods.description: Performs a search for posts with specified parameters, handles pagination, updates search state, and manages truncation info.

methods.name: searchPosts
methods.description: Initiates a post search with given team ID and search terms, using default pagination settings.

methods.name: getMorePostsForSearch
methods.description: Loads additional posts for the current search if not at the end.

methods.name: clearSearch
methods.description: Clears current post and file search results from the state.

methods.name: searchFilesWithParams
methods.description: Performs a search for files with specified parameters, handles pagination, and updates search state.

methods.name: getMoreFilesForSearch
methods.description: Loads additional files for the current search if not at the end.

methods.name: getFlaggedPosts
methods.description: Fetches posts flagged by the current user.

methods.name: getPinnedPosts
methods.description: Fetches pinned posts for a specific channel.
